outreach.subject: A free credit card payoff tool for your readers
outreach.body:
Hi [Name],

I enjoyed your post "[their post title]" — especially [one specific point].

I run HomeMoney Calc, a free, no-sign-up set of US money calculators. Our credit card payoff calculator might be a useful extra for that post: https://homemoneycalc.com/credit-card-payoff-calculator/ (example: $6,000 at 22.9%, paying $250 → Paid off in 2 yr 9 mo).

If it helps your readers, you're welcome to link it or embed it (free embed code is at the bottom of the page). No pressure at all if it's not a fit.

Thanks,
[Your name]
Founder, HomeMoney Calc

ai.headline: Site live hai par monitoring blocked; GA4 aur Cloudflare check zaroori hai
ai.summary: Website ki basic health audit clean hai (22 pages checked, 0 errors), lekin automated monitoring ko Cloudflare ne 403 block kiya hai (ye confirmed site down nahi hai, bas bot security ne request roki hai). GSC connected hai par traffic abhi 0 clicks aur 0 impressions pe hai. GA4 abhi setup nahi hua hai, isliye traffic data track nahi ho raha. AdSense ke liye abhi apply bilkul mat kijiye jab tak steady traffic aur owner review pura na ho jaye.
youDo: GA4 Setup (analytics.google.com): GA4 property create karke web stream banaiye aur Measurement ID add karwaiye, taaki US visitors track ho sakein (calculator inputs query analytics me mat bhejna).

Cloudflare Check (dash.cloudflare.com): Website normal browser me khol kar confirm karein ki khul rahi hai. Uske baad Cloudflare Security Events me check karein ki legitimate search crawlers toh block nahi ho rahe.
